tagline: Leading Italian factoring and supply chain finance specialist serving SMEs and corporate customers
hero_kpi_rationale: Net commission income is the primary growth driver of the business, reflecting the expansion of factoring and confirming services to SMEs and large corporations.

kpis.name: Net Commission and Fee Income
kpis.explanation: Revenue earned from financial services such as factoring and confirming.
kpis.description: Commission income increases due to higher demand for supplier financing and confirming services.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in revenue linked to corporate services.

kpis.name: Total Income
kpis.explanation: Sum of all operating revenues of the company.
kpis.description: Driven by commission income and net interest income.

kpis.name: Net Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net profit grows due to efficient cost management and revenue growth.
kpis.signal: Improved profitability despite an uncertain environment.

kpis.name: Cost/Income Ratio
kpis.explanation: Proportion of operating costs relative to total revenues.
kpis.description: The ratio deteriorates compared to 2023, indicating pressure on operating expenses.

kpis.name: Return on Equity
kpis.explanation: Net profit divided by shareholders' equity.
kpis.description: ROE improves slightly, supported by net profit growth and an increase in shareholders' equity.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Headcount decreases slightly compared to 2023, down from 152 to 149 employees.
kpis.signal: Slight reduction in workforce, likely to optimize costs.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €204.65 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €24.87 Bn in the latest year

risks.title: Dependence on parent bank for compliance
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the 'Organisational structures' section with strong language regarding the transfer of the Compliance function to the parent bank. Central position in the document, assertive language, trend toward increasing dependence, high-weight Regulation category.

risks.title: Cyber risk related to outsourced monitoring
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions outsourcing of the cyber monitoring function, a recent change with cautious language. Clearly positioned in board decisions, moderate but rising intensity, critical Cybersecurity category.

risks.title: Increased competition in the factoring sector
risks.score_rationale: Sector context is referenced via Assifact, with moderate market growth. Neutral language but implicit trend toward competitive pressure, moderately significant category.

risks.title: Rapidly evolving climate regulation
risks.score_rationale: The climate risk action plan is updated in 2024, with active monitoring by the Bank of Italy. Proactive language but highlighting increasing requirements, upward trend, critical Regulation category.

risks.title: Implementation of the DORA cybersecurity regulation
risks.score_rationale: DORA is explicitly cited as applicable from 2025, with binding requirements. High prominence in the text, technical and mandatory language, worsening trend, critical Technology category.

risks.title: Strengthening of AML regulation
risks.score_rationale: The 6th AML package and the new AMLA are cited as major changes. Formal and preparatory language, central position, worsening trend, heavy Regulation category.

risks.title: Dependence on financial reference indices
risks.score_rationale: The plan to replace benchmarks is mentioned following the TUB, but no disruption event reported. Preventive language, secondary position, stable trend, moderate category.

risks.title: Concentration risk on large clients
risks.score_rationale: 7 counterparties exceed 25% of eligible capital, covered by group guarantees. Cautious language, clear position in indicators, stable trend, important Industrial category.
